summary: Assess valuation, funding structures and deal returns with applied M&A finance training. Review the five-day outline and course details.
lede: Acquisition finance training helps finance professionals test a proposed deal’s financial case and support investment decisions. It covers normalising EBITDA and working capital, building DCF valuations and bid sensitivities, comparing funding and consideration structures, and modelling returns and downside scenarios in Excel. Participants also practise presenting valuation, diligence risks and return scenarios in investment committee papers.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who assess, finance or approve acquisition transactions and need to test the financial logic behind a proposed deal.
prerequisites: Advanced finance experience is expected. You should be comfortable interpreting financial statements and using Excel formulas; no coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel installed for the transaction-model exercises.
